h:
Z-Image Turbo gguf模型的comfyui工作流程，它也可以用于fp8或bf16模型，只需绕过和取消绕过相关节点即可。

- GGUF 网络：https://huggingface.co/jayn7/Z-Image-Turbo-GGUF/tree/main
- 文本编码器：https://huggingface.co/jiangchengchengNLP/qwen3-4b-fp8-scaled/tree/main

- VAE：https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/tree/main/split_files/vae


或者如果你想使用 fp8unet，我推荐这个（fp8_scaled_e4m3fn_KJ）：https://civitai.com/models/2169712?modelVersionId=2445746

o.en:
A comfyui workflow for Z-Image Turbo gguf model, it can be used for fp8 or bf16 model too, just bypass and unbypass the related nodes.

- GGUF unet:https://huggingface.co/jayn7/Z-Image-Turbo-GGUF/tree/main
- Text encoder:https://huggingface.co/jiangchengchengNLP/qwen3-4b-fp8-scaled/tree/main

- VAE:https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/tree/main/split_files/vae


or if you want to use fp8 unet, I recommend this one (fp8_scaled_e4m3fn_KJ):https://civitai.com/models/2169712?modelVersionId=2445746
